chunks: And it has been narrated from al-Sadiq عليه السلام that he said:
"A person does not forget the opening takbir."

key_terms.الصَّادِقِ: Imam Jaʿfar al-Sadiq عليه السلام, from whom the hadith is narrated
key_terms.الِافْتِتَاحِ: the opening or commencement, referring here to the opening takbir of salat
key_terms.الْإِنْسَانُ: the human being or person performing the prayer
key_terms.تَكْبِيرَةَ: the takbir, specifically the pronouncement of "Allahu Akbar"

ai.seo_question: Can a person forget Takbirat al-Ihram in prayer?
ai.summary: This hadith states that the opening takbir of salat is not ordinarily subject to forgetfulness. It appears in the context of rulings on forgetfulness in prayer, indicating the legal significance of Takbirat al-Ihram at the beginning of salat.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.998 - It has been narrated from Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq (as) that He said:

"A person does not forget the Takbira al-Ihram (the opening Takbir)."
[REFERENCES]
Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1, p. 343 • Al-Wafi, Vol. 8, p. 915 • Ithbāt al-Hudāt, Part 4, p. 148
